I have an account with coinbase and I linked my checking account to my coinbase account. I figured, "OK, anytime I want to buy bitcoins I can do this without any delay." Ummmm, nope. Still takes about five days.

Heck, even if someone could link to me a page that explains why I'd greatly appreciate it.
Please ELI5: Why does it take several days for my bitcoin purchase to be finalized?

Because it's not exactly an exchange, it's more of a purchase. Two, actually. You send them the money, and because they're processing it from your bank account instead of through a debit or credit transaction, that step takes some time. Then they transfer bitcoin to you, which is pretty quick but still takes time to get the blockchain processing confirmed and completed. The reason it's set up to take this long is so that the system has enough lag time to guarantee nobody gets cheated.

Because they are a link to the legacy fiat system. Your money has to hit their bank account before they release the coins to you. Otherwise you could start the transfer, they release the coins (irreversible) and then you call your bank and stop the payment. They have to cover their bases for scams.
That makes a lot of sense. I hadn't considered that before. Thank you.
